critical_code_review_comments: data_destinations.py _fernet(): derives Fernet key from JWT_SECRET via SHA-256. Correct + deterministic, but rotating JWT_SECRET would silently invalidate all stored destination secrets (they'd decrypt to {} and appear as 'missing_fields'). Consider a dedicated DATA_DEST_SECRET env var so JWT rotation doesn't nuke tenant credentials.

data_destinations.py save_destination(): when the caller PUTs the same provider without secrets, existing_secrets are merged in — good UX. However when a caller wants to actually CLEAR a secret (e.g., rotate to a new bearer token or remove headers_json), passing an empty string is stripped by _clean() so it silently no-ops. Consider a dedicated 'clear' flag or accept null values.

data_destinations.py test_destination(): the psycopg2 import is inside the sync function; if the package is not installed the test endpoint will return a 502 with a generic 'Connection failed' message and no server-side hint. Confirmed psycopg2-binary IS installed in requirements. Fine, but the swallowed exception path masks real config issues — logging the exception type (already done) + returning it in the response body behind a debug flag would help tenants self-serve.

data_destinations.py _public(): status defaults to 'needs_credentials' but for the platform provider _public(None) hard-codes 'active'. Any orphaned destination doc with provider=='platform' would return needs_credentials — probably impossible in practice given save_destination sets status='active' for platform, but worth a unit test.

DataDestinationPanel.jsx choose(): when a user switches provider tabs, draft is reset to EMPTY. If the user was mid-edit on postgres and clicks supabase then back to postgres, their typed URI is gone. Minor UX; may confuse power users.
DataDestinationPanel.jsx test button visibility gated by destination.can_test — after Save success, panel re-fetches load() which correctly toggles the Test button on. Good.

ImageSwap.jsx applyLibraryImage(): if the PATCH privacy call fails (e.g., 404 stale file), it toasts an error but still consumes the click — user must reopen the dialog. Consider auto-refreshing loadLibrary() on error.

ImageSwap.jsx swap-library-image cards use file.url (public) for shared and /api/apps/.../download for private. onApply(file.url) is called AFTER the PATCH — good, so the applied URL is public. Correct.
Server startup: db.data_destinations index is created unique on app_id (server.py:897). Correct.
